meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会通读 GitHub 上全部开放 issue，按根本原因归并成少量主 issue，给每个子 issue 关闭并附标准跳转说明，同时撰写计划文档，并能为某个簇打包一个修复 PR。
howto.when: 当仓库里堆积了 20 个以上看起来雷同的 issue，当你要求对 issue 列表做整理、归类或去重，或提交一个新 bug 想确认它该归到哪个计划时。

say.text: 请通读所有开放 issue，按根本原因把它们归成几个计划主 issue。
say.note: 会打开主 issue，并用标准评论关闭子 issue。

say.text: 这个新 bug 应该归入哪个现有 plan?帮我分流。
say.note: 会在对应主 issue 下追加一条 Round N 评论。

say.text: 给 plan-02 的修复生成一个会关闭所有子 issue 的 PR。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads all open GitHub issues, groups them by root cause into master issues, closes each child with a standard redirect, keeps plan docs, and can prepare one PR that closes a whole cluster at once.
howto.when_en: When a repo has 20+ open issues, when you ask to triage/cluster/dedupe the issue list or route a new bug into an existing plan, or when one PR should close a whole cluster.

say_en.text: Read all open issues and make a few plan-master clusters by root cause.
say_en.note: It opens masters and closes children with the standard comment.

say_en.text: Which existing plan should this new bug go under?
say_en.note: It adds a Round N comment to that master.

say_en.text: Create a PR for plan-02 that closes all its child issues.
say_en.note: Listing Closes #N auto-closes them on merge.
